It only communicates with pre-authorized Virtual Top Nodes (VTNs) and does not accept external requests. • Protection of Data-at-Rest (Implemented): The collected data was stored in a secure server. The storage unit was encrypted, and only specific personnel or certified software can access it. • Protection of data-in-transit (Implemented): All traffic from/to DERs and to PacifiCorp was encrypted, with strict certificate-based authentication and IP whitelisting to ensure trusted exchange. This setup allowed the project to receive and respond to grid signals securely, while maintaining complete control over DER participation and telemetry within a locked-down environment. The project team had been updating and improving the cybersecurity plan on a regular cadence, assessing the vulnerabilities that arise throughout the development of the project. The team was working on the implementation of the cybersecurity framework at project sites and was aiming to start working on the elements of the Phase C checklist in Budget Period 3 when the project was terminated. 6.1.11 Task 11.0.0: Develop Business Model Plan The project team was developing strategies for integrating DER’s into wholesale markets. These strategies were informed on the mechanisms and parameters identified in BP 1. These strategies were focused on integrating the DERs into the Energy Imbalance Market (EIM) and Extended Day Ahead Market (EDAM) for the near term.
